text:
alex.product: Hey folks — pushing PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/11208|#11208> that changes the KV cache eviction path and a small platform routing tweak. Need quick cross-team eyes: @sam.runtime for perf, @owen.infra for eviction / allocation logic, @lena.security for threat surface. jess.platform if you have rollout thoughts.

sam.runtime: on it, putting on my queue now. I'll run a short perf run against the small seq-length traces.

owen.infra: skimming now, one question — does this change affect eviction headers? If so we might need config toggle in orch.

alex.product: yes, it flips a new header `x-evict-mode: shard-aware` when enabled. Default is unchanged. Added tests but I want infra to confirm no rollout hazards.

lena.security: quick note — any new headers mean we should update allowlist and audit doc. Can you add a short note in the PR describing threat model? I can do a quick pass after.

jess.platform: robo-ops: what's the intended rollout? canary? traffic split?

alex.product: plan is canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with automatic rollback on latency regressions. Will add rollout policy to PR description. Need a platform + SRE thumbs for the canary config.

ci-bot: CI status changed to failing — `unit/cache_eviction_test` failing on macos-latest (flaky?).

sam.runtime: that test is flaky in main too recently. Pinging @marta-qa — is that the new flake we saw?

marta-qa: yep saw it earlier. Failure stack:
```
E AssertionError: expected entries 3 but got 2
at cache_test.py:142
```
I can re-run CI once the fix is in.

alex.product: I added a guard to avoid race in the test. Pushed a small fix in the PR (force-pushed) — please re-run CI when you have a sec.

owen.infra: reading code, looks fine. My only ask is to feature-flag the header behind `enable_shard_eviction` config in orch. I'll file a small orch PR to read that flag.

lena.security: I'll review threat model doc when you add it. If it's behind a feature flag and default-off, should be quick.

jess.platform: scheduling canary for tomorrow's 09:00 PT window. If runtime or infra has objections, call it out now.

sam.runtime: no objections. I'll run perf at 06:00 PT and post numbers. If we see token-latency +10% we should hold.

alex.product: thanks all. tagging final list: @sam.runtime @owen.infra @lena.security @jess.platform @marta-qa. Please leave thumb if you can approve; otherwise drop quick notes here.

sam.runtime: :thumbsup:

owen.infra: :eyes: will follow-up with orch PR link shortly.

lena.security: :thumbsup: planning to finish review by EOD.

marta-qa: re-run CI now, assigning to `marta-qa`. CI green except flaky test rerun passed. Ready for merge once security + infra ok.

alex.product: awesome — will hold merge until thumbs from infra+security. Thanks everyone!
